name: Lourian Gel
description: Lourian is a premium nail brand (Lourian Gel) running a Brand Partner / Content Creator program. Approved partners receive free products, a custom affiliate link, 10% off for followers, and earn commission on sales through their link, tracked over a 30-day cookie window.

evidence.summary: 10-15% commission on every purchase through your link, 10% off for followers, free products, 30-day cookie. Uncapped verbatim — FAQ 'Q: Is there a limit to how much I can earn? A: There are no limits. The more you do, the more you earn!'
FAQ: 'You can contact us anytime at support@louriangel.com'

opportunity.title: Lourian Brand Partner / Content Creator Program

reasons.niche_fit: Pure nail / gel nail brand, exactly in the nails category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is explicitly a Content Creator program: sign up, get products shipped, create reviews/content, then earn.
reasons.compensation: Published 10-15% rate AND uncapped, verbatim 'There are no limits. The more you do, the more you earn!'
reasons.contact_access: Published support email on the program page for affiliate questions.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on the page, reviewed by an internal team with email notification.
reasons.credibility: Detailed official program page with FTC disclosure guidance, cookie and payout timing.

name: SIYOU Nails
description: SIYOU is a press-on nail brand operated by Camber Shops LLC, with fulfillment in Randolph, NJ. Its affiliate program pays creators who wear the nails a share of every referred order, tracked via a personal link/code and affiliate dashboard over a 30-day cookie window.

evidence.summary: 30% commission on every order referred, 30% of order subtotal after discounts, 30-day cookie, free to join. No cap wording on the page, so cap is unknown.
Low-saturation evidence verbatim: 'We work with a small crew of creators who actually wear the nails.' Applications judged on where you post and what you make, not just follower count.

opportunity.title: SIYOU Press-On Nail Affiliate Program — Earn 30%

reasons.niche_fit: Pure press-on nails brand, directly in scope.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Creator-first program built around creators who wear the nails and share link/code content.
reasons.compensation: Very high published 30% rate, but no uncapped wording found, so cap stays unknown and score is capped accordingly.
reasons.contact_access: Published contact email and phone on the affiliate page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open short application form on the page, free to join.
reasons.credibility: Full published terms on the official page: commission base, cookie, self-referral, stacking, tax and operator (Camber Shops LLC).

name: ELASCO Skincare
description: ELASCO is a high-performance skincare brand focused on skin longevity, selling products including the RE-HYDRA Serum, MAGI-C Serum (20% vitamin C), Resc-U Spray and Re-Juvenate Elixir. Its homepage says it began with Mukhtar Siddiqui, an organic chemist with four decades formulating skincare, and Linda Lin, its Co-Founder & CEO. Its TYR (Thank You Reward) program pays sharers 25% on every sale made through their link.

evidence.summary: TYR Program pays 25% on every sale through the affiliate's link, plus 5% for life on sales by ambassadors they bring in; uncapped wording verbatim: 'Every time someone buys through it, 25% comes back to you — no cap, no fees, no limit.' and 'Real rewards on every purchase through your link — no cap, no hidden fees.' Page says most applications are reviewed and approved within 1 business day.

Homepage describes ELASCO as 'High-Performance Care for Skin Longevity', founded on chemistry by Mukhtar Siddiqui and CEO Linda Lin, with serums, makeup remover, spray and elixir products listed with prices.

opportunity.title: Become an ELASCAN — TYR Program (Thank You Reward)

reasons.niche_fit: Pure indie skincare brand built entirely around serums and skin longevity, a direct fit for skincare creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program page tells members to share by text, email, social or blog and provides ready-made images, captions and product facts.
reasons.compensation: Published 25% on every sale plus 5% lifetime network reward, with explicit 'no cap, no fees, no limit' wording.
reasons.contact_access: No email was published on the fetched page; access is only via the on-page application form and ELASCAN portal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open on the page and the brand says most are approved within 1 business day.
reasons.credibility: Named founders and a disclosed 30-day participant survey (n=16) on the homepage support credibility.

name: CA Perfume Club
description: CA Perfume Club is a California fragrance brand that publishes a HumanSafe ingredient-transparency framework disclosing every ingredient and a MEi Mood Architecture framework mapping scents to moods. Ambassadors receive a complimentary 1.7 fl oz fragrance and create video reviews and UGC content.

evidence.summary: Tiered commissions published: Studio 10% affiliate commission, Curator 15%, Maison 20%, with a complimentary fragrance and ambassador badge at entry tier; no earnings-cap wording was found on the fetched page, so cap is labeled unknown.

Program is described as 'Join a select group of brand ambassadors' with 'Spots are limited', no minimum follower count, and nano and micro creators welcome; creators share a video review and UGC package to unlock Studio status.

opportunity.title: CA Perfume Club Brand Ambassador Program — complimentary fragrance, UGC video review, 10%-20% tiered commission

reasons.niche_fit: Small California fragrance house with ingredient transparency is a direct clean-fragrance fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Explicit UGC package and video review requirement, complimentary product, and nano/micro creators welcome with no follower minimum.
reasons.compensation: Published 10%-20% tiered rate, but no uncapped wording was found, so compensation is scored mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Published hello@caperfume.com contact plus an application form on the same official page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now, though the program is selective and spots are stated to be limited.
reasons.credibility: Official site publishes its HumanSafe and MEi frameworks openly for every product.

name: Amal
description: Amal makes handcrafted small-batch Sudanese makhmaria, a solid fragrance/body balm crafted with 100% natural shea butter, oud, rose and botanical oils. The brand presents itself as Sudanese luxury natural cosmetics rooted in centuries-old heritage recipes passed from mother to daughter.

evidence.summary: Affiliate page states 15% commission, 7-day cookie and weekly payouts, and in Program Details quotes verbatim: 'No cap on earnings' — also '15% on all product sales' and 'Commission on all products'.
Homepage describes handcrafted makhmaria with shea butter, oud, rose and botanical oils, handcrafted in small batches following Sudanese heritage methods.

opportunity.title: Amal Affiliate Program — 15% commission for beauty and skincare influencers, content creators and bloggers

reasons.niche_fit: Indie small-batch fragrance/body makhmaria fits the fragrance and body-care scope directly.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Page invites beauty influencers and creators to share links on social media and blogs, but does not describe a formal UGC package.
reasons.compensation: Published 15% rate plus verbatim uncapped wording and weekly payouts.
reasons.contact_access: Public application on the affiliate page with WhatsApp contact mentioned, but no email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open and stated to be reviewed within 48 hours.
reasons.credibility: Official site with detailed product, heritage and program terms published.

name: Watts Beauty USA
description: Watts Beauty is a clean beauty skincare brand operating since 2005, selling serums, creams and related skin and hair products. Its affiliate page says its mission celebrates the beauty of every woman and supports programs and shelters for domestic violence survivors. Affiliates earn cash commission on referred orders and reorders through personalized links.

evidence.summary: Affiliate option pays 15%-30% commission on every referred order and reorder, paid daily via PayPal or store credit, with 6-month tracking; uncapped wording verbatim: 'Affiliates can earn unlimited cash with 15%-30% commission on every referred order and reorder'. The page also states 'Unlimited referrals for unlimited rewards' for its referrer option, and notes applicants must be a customer to sign up.
The on-page affiliate application asks applicants for their website(s) and Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok links, showing the program is aimed at social creators and influencers.

opportunity.title: Become an Affiliate (Earn Cash) — Watts Beauty Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Long-running clean skincare brand whose affiliate copy specifically addresses sharing skincare with online audiences.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Application form collects Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok links, evidencing creator-focused recruitment.
reasons.compensation: Published 15%-30% commission range (15% used as the base rate) with explicit 'earn unlimited cash' wording, though sign-up requires being a customer.
reasons.contact_access: No email was published on the fetched page; access is via the on-page application form only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Page invites applications with 'Apply Today, Start Earning Today' and an open application form.
reasons.credibility: Brand states it has operated since 2005 and redirected $563,000 per year back to customers.

name: SOSS
description: SOSS (So Organic, So Suave) is a Black-owned, founder-led men's beard care brand founded in Los Angeles in 2020, making natural beard butter, a daily beard soufflé moisturizer, and African black soap for every beard texture. The founder personally reads every partnership submission and runs affiliate, barbershop partner, brand ambassador, and content-sharing routes through one Join Us page.

evidence.summary: Official Join Us page lists an Affiliate Program: 'For creators with a real audience and real taste. Earn commission on every sale you drive with your own link and code.' No commission rate or cap wording is published, so rate is null and cap is unknown. Founder states: 'Every submission comes straight to me' and lists questions contact team@sossd.co.

FAQ states the Affiliate Program 'welcomes creators of every size, from under 5K followers on up,' is for creators on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, podcast, blog, or newsletter, and that the founder reads each submission personally and replies by email if there is a fit — evidence of a small, founder-run program actively recruiting small/first creators (low saturation).

opportunity.title: SOSS Affiliate Program / Brand Ambassador — Join Us

reasons.niche_fit: Pure men's beard care and grooming brand, squarely in the Group M scope.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Four creator routes (content sharing, affiliate, barbershop, ambassador) with featured-content reposting, explicitly open to under-5K creators.
reasons.compensation: Commission is promised but no rate is published anywhere on the fetched pages, so compensation is capped low per the rubric.
reasons.contact_access: Direct published email team@sossd.co plus a single application page read personally by the founder.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Join Us application is live and open to creators of every size.
reasons.credibility: Registered U.S. trademark (Reg. No. 5,920,708) and press features (Essence, Ebony, Vogue, GQ, Men's Health) stated on the official FAQ.

name: Lumity
description: Lumity sells a clinically tested supplement and skincare range, including Skin Nutrients Facial Oil, Body Oil and a Cleansing Balm, positioned around healthy ageing and skin, hair and nail support. Its Referral Program FAQ dedicates its Ambassador Program to bloggers and influencers who produce health and beauty content. Ambassadors earn 15% commission on sales, including recurring commission while referred customers stay subscribed.

evidence.summary: FAQ Q5: ambassadors receive 15% commission on sales (partners, who are medical professionals, receive 25%). FAQ Q6 'How much money can I make?' — uncapped wording verbatim: 'There's no limit on the amount of commissions you can earn, so the more people you successfully refer to buy Lumity, the more money you'll make.' FAQ Q11 gives maria@lumitylife.co.uk for program questions.
FAQ Q3 states verbatim: 'Our Ambassador Program is dedicated to bloggers and influencers that produce and share health and beauty content and would like to recommend Lumity to their readers.'

opportunity.title: Lumity Ambassador Program — Referral Program for Bloggers and Influencers

reasons.niche_fit: Range spans supplements as well as skincare (facial oil, body oil, cleansing balm), so the skincare fit is real but partial.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Ambassador tier is explicitly dedicated to bloggers and influencers producing health and beauty content.
reasons.compensation: Published 15% ambassador commission with an explicit FAQ answer that there is no limit on commissions, plus recurring subscription commission.
reasons.contact_access: A named program contact email, maria@lumitylife.co.uk, is published in the FAQ for questions.
reasons.opportunity_availability: FAQ describes open sign-up and approval into the Referral Program with a dashboard and unique referral link.
reasons.credibility: Homepage presents clinically tested products and award-winning positioning for an established wellness brand.

name: odaban
description: odaban is a German antiperspirant brand for managing sweat problems, sold through its own online shop and listed in dm Austria, BIPA and pharmacies in Germany and Austria. Its spray is dermatologically tested and described as long-lasting and versatile for reducing sweat formation.

evidence.summary: Brand ambassador page quotes verbatim: 'Unlimited earning potential: The more customers you successfully refer, the more you earn. There is no upper limit!' and in FAQ: 'There is no limit to your earning potential' — commission is stated as 'usually 10%'.
Page states over 160,000 customers in the online shop, free participation, no minimum sales limit, and monthly payout by bank transfer or PayPal.

opportunity.title: odaban Brand Ambassador Program — earn commission on every sale with no minimum sales requirement

reasons.niche_fit: Antiperspirant body care is squarely in the body-care scope, though it is a single-product niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program invites ambassadors to share their link on social media and websites, with no explicit UGC deliverables published.
reasons.compensation: Published usually-10% rate plus two explicit uncapped statements on the same page.
reasons.contact_access: Join buttons on the official page lead to the partner registration, but no partnerships email was published on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join now with no minimum sales limit stated.
reasons.credibility: Established brand citing 160,000 shop customers and pharmacy and dm/BIPA listings in Germany and Austria.

name: Unveil Hair Care
description: Unveil is a small hair care brand selling hair care products and scalp massagers. It has launched an Affiliate/Ambassador Program inviting people to share their love of Unveil products with their audience and earn commission, with a brand specialist reaching out if there is a good fit.

evidence.summary: Uncapped verbatim: 'We offer a commission-based opportunity with NO limits to how much you can earn.' No commission percentage is published on the page, so rate is null.
Low-saturation evidence: page announces a newly launched program — 'Unveil is Excited to Announce Our Affiliate/Ambassador Program has Launched!' — with applications via the form on the page.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure hair care brand, in scope for hair-care creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Affiliate/Ambassador program explicitly framed around sharing products with your 'tribe'.
reasons.compensation: Uncapped verbatim ('NO limits to how much you can earn') but no published commission rate, so compensation is scored ≤8 per the rules.
reasons.contact_access: Application form on the page only; no published email found on the fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Newly launched program with an open application form on the page.
reasons.credibility: Official page is very thin — no rate, network, cookie or payout terms published.
